title: Africa: AFRICANDO Will Deepen Africa-US Commercial Ties'

description: [This Day] Academic leaders and technology experts have warned that Africa risks permanent economic dependence on technologically advanced nations unless it urgently shifts from consuming imported Artificial Intelligence (AI) technologies to developing indigenous solutions and digital infrastructure.
title: Africa: Icair 2026 - Africa Risks Economic Dependence Without Home-Grown Ai Technologies, Experts Warn

description: [Ghanaian Times] Dr Wayne Dyer laments that many of us with normal faculties have mentally handicapped ourselves and victimised ourselves through belief systems. "We limit ourselves in search for security, never realising how easily others can confine us further, using our limitations against us."
title: Africa: Self-Dependency

description: [Ghanaian Times] PRESIDENT John Dramani Mahama has said he will push for a trade synergy between Africa and the Caribbean when he resumes the chairmanship of the African Union (AU) next year.
title: Africa: Ghana to Champion Africa-Caricom Trade Bloc - Pres Mahama

description: [RootsToFoods Capital Series] In a RootsToFoods Capital Series interview, Kanini Mutooni of the Draper Richards Kaplan Foundation follows one Kenyan cold-chain company from DRK's first check to the path to financial sustainability, and Dr. Frank Aswani of the African Venture Philanthropy Alliance explains what it would take for ten more to do the same.
title: Africa: Africa Is Not Short of Money - It Is Short of Risk Capital

description: [allAfrica] In this guest column for AllAfrica, the Dutch Trade and Development Minister and the head of the World Health Organization stress that addressing viral health crises anywhere protects everyone everywhere. The government of the Netherlands is committing funding both for the current Ebola crisis and flexible funding to quickly respond to new or emerging global threats.
title: Africa: Deadly Viruses Know No Borders, Nor Should Our Resolve to Stop Them

description: [Africapractice] Africa Made It, the continental movement driving Africa's industrial sovereignty, today officially launched its campaign,  "Power, Protect and Purchase,"  at the CANEX weekend in Lagos, Nigeria. Aimed at unlocking USD 34 billion in annual GDP contribution through a structural transition from unprocessed raw cotton exports to end-to-end local garment processing, the initiative seeks to turn Africa's vast natural wealth into sovereign, self-sustaining economic power.
title: Africa: Africa Made It Unveils Blueprint To Capture Usd 34B In Gdp And Accelerate African Industrial Sovereignty

description: [Bird Story Agency] Africa needs more climate finance -- and greater accountability for the capital already at work. Just Share executive director Nicole Martens argues that banks, investors and pension funds must turn climate commitments into measurable changes in what they finance, backed by stronger regulation and scrutiny.
title: Africa: Beyond Financing The Transition - Africa Needs a Financial System That Is Accountable

description: [ENA] Addis Ababa -- Ethiopia's Minister of Women and Social Affairs, Shawit Shanka, called on African countries to ensure women's equal participation in political leadership and economic decision-making, saying the continent cannot realize its full development potential while marginalizing half of its population.
title: Africa: Ethiopia Says Women's Leadership Indispensable to Africa's Economic Transformation

description: [WHO] The World Health Organization (WHO) today reported major global progress against neglected tropical diseases (NTDs), with 63 countries having eliminated at least one NTD by June 2026, up from 42 at the end of 2020.

description: [WHO] Expert groups convened by the World Health Organization (WHO) have recommended adding two new Ebola vaccine candidates to the ongoing Tumaini clinical trial in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). The recommendation marks the first time vaccines specifically designed to protect against Bundibugyo virus, the virus responsible for the current outbreak, will be evaluated during an outbreak of the disease.
title: Africa: Two New Candidate Vaccines to Join Ebola Trial As Treatment Research Advances

description: [The Conversation Africa] Parts of Africa are facing the fastest-spreading Ebola epidemic on record. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo virus, one of several types of Ebola virus, and has grown dramatically in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). Cases have now appeared in other countries too.
title: Africa: Why an Ebola Outbreak in Africa Doesn't Mean an Epidemic in Britain

description: [The Conversation Africa] The use of digital agriculture is expanding across Africa. Tools like artificial intelligence (AI), sensors and blockchain are helping farmers receive information about weather, pests, markets and farm management. AI can analyse images and other farm data to detect problems or support decisions. Digital traceability systems can record where food comes from and what happens to it along the supply chain.
title: Africa: AI and Blockchain Are Coming to African Farms - 4 Things Must Happen for Farmers to Benefit
